cell_key: balls-strikes|base|outs; base bits: 1 first, 2 second, 4 third
estimator: count departure against RE24 of the play's end state (gate 11.1)
ledger_convention: state value: three outs 0; count 0-0 or ended RE24; otherwise RE288. Event value = value(after) - value(before) + runs at its index.
season_table: RE24_s + lambda_s x the pooled count departure (gate 11.2, owner question RE288-Q1 default (a)); d_raw is each season's raw departure
what: RE288: mean runs from a pitch to the end of its half-inning by the state before the pitch (balls, strikes, 3-bit base code, outs), per MLB regular season: RE24 plus a count departure measured against RE24 of the play's end state, pooled over 2018 to 2026 and frozen. Descriptive, measurement only; no player value.
